description: Implementation of the ClientService interface for managing Client entities, including retrieving clients with remote project data, and CRUD operations, with HTTP request handling and exception management.

classes.name: ClientServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing client-related business logic, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting clients, with remote API interactions and response processing.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves a client by ID, fetching associated project data from a remote service if not already present.

methods.name: processResponse
methods.description: Processes the JSON response body from the remote client system and adds project data to the client entity.

methods.name: makeRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to fetch project data for a client from the remote service.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new client in the repository after ensuring it does not already exist.

methods.name: updateClient
methods.description: Updates an existing client in the repository after verifying it exists.

methods.name: deleteClient
methods.description: Deletes a client from the repository after confirming its existence.
